title: Cut over Studio Compiler to v2.1.0 with exact locked Interface Package inputs
body:
## Goal

Integrate the **released CA Skill Compiler v2.1.0 Development Build API** into Skill Studio as the authoritative source + immutable Interface Package linking + artifact build path. Feed the exact snapshots imported and locked by #261 into the Compiler. Do not build a Studio-owned linker, dependency resolver, package format, or parallel trust model.

The Studio must keep three outcomes separate:

- source validation and Interface Package linking/build;
- Host Admission requirements that an independent Host must verify;
- Runtime Execution requirements and actual execution evidence.

A successful Development Build is `VALIDATED / LINKED / BUILT / NOT_ADMITTED`. `NOT_ADMITTED` is the intentional Development profile boundary, not a failed build and not production authorization.

## Verified release contract boundary (2026-11-24)

The official [CA Skill Compiler v2.1.0 release](https://github.com/odango-chan/ca-skill-compiler/releases/tag/v2.1.0) is published (not a prerelease), source SHA `b67fbb56c34d15b8d5a0903c8a7ca93d608f8f65`.

**Do not confuse the two API families shipped by that product:**

1. The existing `connectionagent.io/compiler-build-request/v1alpha5` and BuildResult/Artifact family remains frozen to the v2.0.2 artifact bytes. Its `resolvedDependencies[]` and `trustedBuildContext` are not the new Development Build interface-link contract. The embedded artifact generator identity remains `v2.0.2` by design.
2. v2.1.0 adds the separate Development family:
   - `connectionagent.io/compiler-development-build-request/v1alpha1`
   - `connectionagent.io/compiler-development-build-result/v1alpha1`
   - `connectionagent.io/compiler-development-artifact/v1alpha1`
   - `connectionagent.io/interface-package/v1alpha1`
   - `connectionagent.io/interface-dependency-lock/v1alpha1`
   - WASM exports `skillcBuildDevelopment` and `skillcVerifyDevelopment`.

Normative machine contracts are under [`contracts/development/v1alpha1/`](https://github.com/odango-chan/ca-skill-compiler/tree/v2.1.0/contracts/development/v1alpha1). The Development BuildRequest contains exact Skill `files[]`, `targets[]`, `lock` and `snapshots[]`; it does **not** accept `trustedBuildContext`, Owner attestations, Deployment Grants, live Evidence or Provider bindings. Instead, it emits Host Admission and Runtime Execution requirement files for their independent owners.

The Studio integration has two implementation slices with different current states:

- [PR #272](https://github.com/odango-chan/ca-skill-studio-demo/pull/272) is **MERGED** into current `main` (merge commit `a8633553615d786e360a62c2b0042a27ae92d9d3`). It constructs the official v2.1.0 Development Build request from the resolver's exact immutable snapshots, builds the reachable lock closure from Contract roots and locked manifests, verifies original snapshot bytes, computes the Compiler dependency digest, and fails closed on missing roots/transitive snapshots, tampering, unsupported dependency kinds, cycles, version conflicts, unready resolver state, wrong root IDs and source-only Contracts.
- [PR #276](https://github.com/odango-chan/ca-skill-studio-demo/pull/276) remains **OPEN / Draft**. It pins Compiler source commit `b67fbb56c34d15b8d5a0903c8a7ca93d608f8f65`, verifies the official v2.1.0 Worker release bundle against `SHA256SUMS`, and exposes `buildDevelopment` / `verifyDevelopment` through Node and browser Workers. Its prior exact-head CI passed on `7d6adebaca12f09d5ddc5e04f7457b8c15aa595e`, but that evidence is historical, not a current-main gate.
- Current `main` at this refresh is `a8633553615d786e360a62c2b0042a27ae92d9d3`. #276 still targets the old base branch at `3b3c4ac9d4b3a2f2e2380793d028d92f24c62c27`; its head is 41 commits ahead of the merge base and current `main` is 315 commits ahead. It must be rebased/reapplied onto current `main` and all exact-head gates rerun before it can be considered for merge.
- #276's successful historical checks include PR Verify, Native Windows, IDE Host, Theia Browser-Only, Theia Browser Host, Published Interface ZIP and Pages/default-root Chromium. Those do not replace the required post-refresh checks.

The product cutover is **not complete**. The following distinctions are verified against current `main`:

- **#261 import/lock prerequisite is implemented.** PR #267 was merged as `11b124679746644f79bd82e296e253b7c463c179`; PR #270 was merged as `d3b1d36e6574d7d9c87473a0ee2340727140fb71`. Studio's `skillc.lock/v0.1` is the persistent, project-local immutable snapshot/provenance lock. It stores exact bytes and re-verifies them; it is not the Compiler's lock schema. Do **not** replace it or migrate it into another project-lock format.
- **Compiler lock is a derived BuildRequest value.** #272 constructs `connectionagent.io/interface-dependency-lock/v1alpha1` from exact Contract aliases and selected immutable Interface Package snapshots. It must not be persisted as a second competing project lock.
- **Current default Example roots do not yet match the Compiler v2.1.0 package contract.** The three current Contracts declare `ca-context: urn:connectionagent:ca:host-context` and `mas: urn:openamsm:mas:tool-contracts`. The project lock currently stores `ca-context` as `schema-bundle`, `mas` as `tool-catalog`, and `ca-client` as `interface-package`. The Compiler v2.1.0 Development request builder accepts only formal `connectionagent.io/interface-package/v1alpha1` snapshots. The `ca-client` v1.1.0 package exports eleven public READ Tools / two Capabilities and is an editor IntelliSense dependency; it is **not** the `mas` Owner package and is not declared by these Contracts. Do not infer or substitute it for `mas` or `ca-context`.
- **Upstream package publication is a real prerequisite for the current MAS Example.** The Owner's `urn:openamsm:mas:tool-contracts` source (v1alpha4 ToolCatalog, CapabilityContracts, Schemas and Evidence Guarantees) and the Host's `urn:connectionagent:ca:host-context` Development fixture must be made available as exact formal Interface Packages, preserving their existing Package IDs/versions and owner/source provenance. This must not package or expose the private Runtime-only bindings from ca-client-tools#37 as public callables. If those upstream packages are not published, the current Example remains `BLOCKED / NOT_LINKED`; Studio must not synthesize package.json or rewrite the immutable source bytes.
- **The real released `ca-client-tools_interface_1.1.0.zip` remains a separate positive integration fixture.** It must be the root of a synthetic Skill whose Contract explicitly declares alias `ca-client` and its exact Package ID. This proves real published-package parity, but does not qualify the current MAS Create/Modify/Release Example.
- Package Audit does not yet use Development Build/Verify as its authoritative gate; AI Authoring's exact-candidate gate has not yet been switched. Shared diagnostics/status projection is also open.

**Zero-root contract boundary:** Compiler v2.1.0's published Development Build request schema requires non-empty `snapshots`, `lock.roots` and `lock.packages`. A Skill with no Contract dependency roots cannot produce a v2.1.0 Development Build request. For now Studio must show an explicit no-root/source-only state, run no Development Build, produce no Artifact and must not invent a dependency or silently fall back to the frozen v2.0.2 Build API. `NOT_ADMITTED` is reserved for a successful Development Build result; it must not be fabricated when no result exists. If deterministic zero-dependency Assurance Skills must produce Artifacts, that requires a separately versioned Compiler contract change, not a Studio workaround against frozen v2.1.0.

**Branch freshness:** exact-head CI previously passed on #272 `8abffc752f456150f5a66236bbd3060da292b10f` and #276 `7d6adebaca12f09d5ddc5e04f7457b8c15aa595e`, but these heads are stale against the current integration baseline. #272 is 67 commits behind current `main`; #276 is 9 commits behind its #272 base branch. Rebase/reapply the reviewed deltas and rerun all exact-head acceptance before merge or product cutover.

Digest boundary: the resolver's existing Studio snapshot digest and Compiler v2.1.0's `CA-SKILL-DEPENDENCY-SNAPSHOT\\0v1\\0` digest are deliberately distinct. The request builder re-verifies the former against the original locked bytes, then computes the latter from those same original bytes. Never substitute the Studio digest or ZIP SHA-256 for the Compiler dependency snapshot digest.

## Implementation status and next delivery order (2026-11-25)

### Completed implementation slices

- [x] Pin the official Compiler v2.1.0 source and Worker release bundle; verify the published bundle checksum before staging it in supported host builds. Evidence: #276 exact-head IDE Host, Theia Browser-Only, Theia Browser Host and Pages workflows PASS.
- [x] Expose the official Development Build / VerifyDevelopment callbacks through Node and browser Worker protocols. The Worker remains isolated from network resolution, workspace filesystem, credentials, Owner trust and Runtime dispatch.
- [x] Keep the frozen v1alpha5 Build/Verify API distinct from the v2.1.0 Development API. The frozen artifact generator identity remains v2.0.2; no silent fallback from a failed Development Build.
- [x] Implement Compiler v2.1.0 dependency snapshot digest framing and reproduce the official Development Build fixture.
- [x] Construct Development `snapshots[]`, `lock.roots[]` and reachable `lock.packages[]` from exact resolver snapshots, Contract aliases and locked package manifests.
- [x] Fail closed on stale/tampered snapshot bytes, unsupported dependency kinds, missing roots/transitive snapshots, duplicate aliases, dependency cycles, conflicting Package versions, wrong root Package IDs, unready resolver state and source-only Contracts.
- [x] Verify Development Build + VerifyDevelopment with the official Compiler fixture through Node/WASM and real Theia browser Worker. Evidence includes `VALIDATED / LINKED / BUILT / NOT_ADMITTED`, tampered artifact rejection and corrupted snapshot rejection.

### Still open — product integration and external package prerequisites

- [ ] Rebase/reapply #272 onto current `main` and #276 onto the refreshed #272 head; rerun all exact-head CI/Chromium acceptance. Historical PASS on stale heads is not a current merge gate.
- [ ] Fix the request builder to select the exact Contract-root/transitive Interface Package closure only. Unrelated project dependencies such as the editor-only `ca-client` package must not block a Skill that does not declare them; a declared root alias resolving to `tool-catalog` or `schema-bundle` must fail with an explicit unsupported-kind diagnostic.
- [ ] Publish the MAS Owner v1alpha4 contract as a formal Interface Package for Package ID `urn:openamsm:mas:tool-contracts` (CallableCatalog, CapabilityCatalog, Schema and EvidenceDescriptor exports as applicable), without publishing private Runtime-only bindings as public Tools.
- [ ] Publish the Host-owned `urn:connectionagent:ca:host-context` Development fixture as a formal Interface Package, preserving the Development Fixture boundary and exact Schema bytes.
- [ ] Pin/import those formal packages under the existing Contract aliases `mas` and `ca-context`; do not rewrite the Contract aliases, Package IDs or source bytes to accommodate the Studio.
- [ ] Add a real-release positive test: `ca-client-tools_interface_1.1.0.zip` is the root of a synthetic Skill whose Contract explicitly declares `ca-client`; verify official Compiler v2.1.0 Development Build + VerifyDevelopment and Node/WASM/browser parity. This is separate from MAS Example qualification.
- [ ] Define and implement the Studio no-root state. No Development Build request, no Artifact, no fallback and no fabricated `NOT_ADMITTED`; preserve local authoring diagnostics. A future zero-dependency deterministic Artifact requires a separately versioned Compiler contract change.
- [ ] Switch Package Audit to the shared Development Build request builder + Worker Build/Verify path using exact current locked Interface Package bytes.
- [ ] Switch AI Authoring's exact-candidate gate to Development Build + VerifyDevelopment over the same current candidate bytes and dependency-lock generation. Preserve user-confirmed native Apply/Undo and revoke prior approval when the candidate or lock generation changes.
- [ ] Project Compiler inspection/diagnostics and separate Source / Interface Link / Artifact / Host Admission / Runtime requirement states into Package Explorer, LSP and Problems. Do not present `NOT_ADMITTED` as a failure or as production authorization.

### Required implementation order

1. Refresh #272/#276 against current `main`, fix root-closure selection and rerun exact-head acceptance.
2. Complete the upstream MAS Owner and Host Context Interface Package publication prerequisites; pin them under the existing Contract aliases.
3. Integrate Package Audit through the shared Development Build path; prove the real released `ca-client-tools_interface_1.1.0.zip` positive fixture and the actual MAS roots separately, with Go/WASM/browser parity.
4. Integrate AI Authoring's candidate Build + Verify gate using the same request builder and dependency generation; prove stale candidates are blocked and native Undo restores the exact original buffer.
5. Complete no-root state handling, shared inspection/diagnostic projection and truthful lifecycle statuses.

No new parallel resolver, project lock, package format, trust model or Compiler implementation is authorized by this sequence.
## Implementation

### P0 — Pin and expose the released Compiler

- [x] Pin the exact v2.1.0 release source/artifact identity and verify release assets against the published `SHA256SUMS`; use the same Compiler/WASM bytes in IDE Host, Theia Browser Host, Browser-Only and Pages.
- [x] Extend the browser and Node Worker adapters to expose `buildDevelopment` and `verifyDevelopment` through the official `skillcBuildDevelopment` / `skillcVerifyDevelopment` callbacks. Keep the worker isolated: no network resolver, workspace filesystem, credentials, Owner trust or Runtime dispatch.
- [x] Validate the exact Development BuildRequest / BuildResult API identities and required fields. Fail closed on malformed JSON, missing callbacks, worker timeout, invalid output, or unsupported API identity.
- [x] Keep the frozen v1alpha5 Build/Verify family clearly separate if it remains exposed; never label it the v2.1.0 Development Build or use it as a silent fallback for a failed Development Build.

### P0 — Convert the existing immutable Interface Package locks into the Compiler contract

- [ ] Use the exact locked bytes produced by #261. Parse the frozen root `package.json` manifest only from that verified snapshot; do not re-fetch GitHub, resolve mutable refs, or rewrite manifest bytes.
- [x] Implement and test the exact Compiler `ComputeDependencySnapshotDigest` framing: `CA-SKILL-DEPENDENCY-SNAPSHOT\0v1\0`, big-endian file count/path lengths/byte lengths, UTF-8 path ordering, and original file bytes. Cross-check against Compiler-published vectors and Go/WASM results.
- [x] Build `snapshots[]` from exact `{key:{packageId,version,snapshotDigest},files:[{path,bytes}]}` values.
- [x] Build `lock.roots[]` from exact Skill dependency aliases and package keys; build every `lock.packages[]` entry from the corresponding package manifest's direct dependency edges. The supplied snapshots and lock must form the complete exact closure.
- [x] Fail closed on missing transitive snapshots, duplicate dependency aliases, package-version conflicts, stale/tampered snapshot bytes, wrong root Package IDs, unsupported dependency kinds and cycles.
- [ ] After the upstream MAS/Host Interface Packages are published, cross-check each imported package manifest's direct dependency edges against the selected Compiler Lock, plus duplicate export identities and stale/unknown persisted aliases. The Studio `skillc.lock/v0.1` is not being migrated or replaced. Do not invent a package, edge, digest, owner, or grant.
- [x] Keep `skillc.lock/v0.1` as the Studio project-local import/provenance lock; it owns exact immutable snapshots and source metadata. Do not replace it with a second persistent Compiler lock. #272 derives `connectionagent.io/interface-dependency-lock/v1alpha1` inside each Development BuildRequest from Contract roots and the exact selected snapshot closure. No legacy language compatibility parser or silent lock refresh.
- [x] Unit-test the zero-root case: the request builder rejects source-only Contracts with `DEVELOPMENT_BUILD_NO_ROOT_DEPENDENCIES` and does not synthesize a package. The released v2.1.0 request schema independently requires non-empty `snapshots`, `lock.roots` and `lock.packages`.
- [ ] Implement the Studio no-root product state: no Compiler request/artifact/fallback; distinguish SKILL.md-only LLM-guided Skills from Assurance Skills with no external roots. Do not fabricate `NOT_ADMITTED`; a zero-dependency deterministic Artifact requires a separately versioned Compiler contract change.

### P0 — Connect Development Build to Package Audit and AI Authoring

- [ ] Route Skill Package validation/build through the same Development Build request builder and exact locked snapshots; do not create separate request assembly for AI Authoring.
- [ ] Show distinct statuses for source validation, Interface Link, artifact build, Host Admission requirements and Runtime Execution requirements. A successful Development artifact is `NOT_ADMITTED`; it must never be displayed as production-qualified or Runtime-ready.
- [ ] Update AI Authoring's exact-candidate gate to use Development Build + `VerifyDevelopment` over the same candidate bytes and dependency lock. A verified `VALIDATED / LINKED / BUILT / NOT_ADMITTED` result may authorize **editing the local source buffer only**; it does not authorize Tool dispatch, deployment or Runtime execution.
- [ ] Apply/Undo remains native, user-confirmed, revision-bound and fail-closed. A changed Procedure, Package generation, dependency lock or candidate digest revokes the previous Apply decision.
- [ ] Host Admission requirements are displayed as requirements, not synthesized grants. Actual Owner/Capability authorization must come from an independent Host trust source; the Interface Package publisher field and a successful Development Build are not Owner authorization.

### P1 — Inspection and diagnostics

- [ ] Project Compiler-returned callable/Schema source locations from the Development artifact/official inspection surface into the existing Package Explorer, LSP and Problems model. Do not duplicate the package index or infer trust from editor hints.
- [ ] Normalize Development diagnostics into the shared diagnostic contract with exact path/line/column where provided. Keep local syntax, Interface Link, Host Admission and Runtime requirements separate.
- [ ] Report `NOT_RUN`, `BLOCKED`, `FAILED`, `VALIDATED`, `LINKED`, `BUILT` and `NOT_ADMITTED` truthfully; never turn absence of an external trust fact into PASS.

## Acceptance

- [x] Exact v2.1.0 release asset identity and SHA256SUMS verified in all host builds.
- [ ] Real released `ca-client-tools_interface_1.1.0.zip` from #270 becomes an exact Development snapshot and lock root; snapshot digest equals Compiler Go and WASM outputs.
- [x] Positive Development Build validates source, links the Interface Package closure, builds the deterministic artifact, returns `NOT_ADMITTED`, and passes `VerifyDevelopment` (official Compiler fixture; real published #270 package root is tracked separately).
- [ ] Negative tests cover corrupted bytes/digest, wrong package identity/version, missing transitive snapshot, wrong root alias, manifest/lock edge mismatch, duplicate export identity, broken Schema `$ref`, malformed source, invalid target and altered artifact bytes.
- [x] IDE Host, Theia Browser Host, Browser-Only and Pages/Chromium exercise the same exact Development request and result.
- [ ] AI Authoring uses the exact current candidate and same locked dependency generation; Apply is enabled only after Development Build and Verify pass. Undo restores the exact original buffer.
- [ ] A successful Development Build is reported as `VALIDATED / LINKED / BUILT / NOT_ADMITTED`; no Owner, Deployment, Runtime, 5GC or MAS qualification is claimed.

## Explicit boundaries

- No Studio-owned compiler, linker, version resolver, package format, arbitrary remote `$ref` resolver or mutable dependency checkout.
- No trust inferred from Interface Package publisher, manifest, ZIP hash, LSP completion or Compiler Development output.
- No Owner/Provider/Host/Runtime implementation in Compiler integration; Host Admission and Runtime requirements remain separately owned.
- No real 5GC/MAS E2E claim from synthetic or Development Build evidence.
- #261 owns immutable Interface Package import and editor IntelliSense; this issue owns the Compiler v2.1.0 Development Build integration.
